unitTitle: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous - Conditionals Type 1 - When/If

pairsWith.noteUz: Kelajak shakllari (davomi), will/Present Continuous, 1-tur shart gap mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 5-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET (27-bet, PDF 26). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '5'.

CHAP USTUN (6-mashq davomi, rasmlar bilan): • move to the country/March 12 (RASM: mayoq va uy) • buy a farm (RASM: ferma) • get a puppy (RASM: kuchuk) • take their children to their new school/September 7 (RASM: oila - ota, ona, ikki bola) • have a house-warming party (RASM: 'Welcome to our new home' kartochka)
7) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the future simple or the present continuous.' 1 The repairman ...... (come) to fix the washing machine tomorrow. 2 A: I'm cold. B: I ...... (get) you an extra blanket. 3 ...... (you/drive) me to the airport on Tuesday? 4 Rachel ...... (fly) to the Bahamas next week. 5 My son ...... (be) five in August. 6 She ...... (have) lunch with Doug this afternoon. 7 ...... (you/do) the washing-up please? 8 Rob and Molly ...... (celebrate) their wedding anniversary on Sunday. 9 When ...... (the Greens/leave) for Lima? 10 People ...... (live) in underwater cities in the future.

O'NG USTUN - 'Conditionals Type 1':
8) 'Match the prompts in column A to the ones in column B. Then, complete the dialogues below, as in the example.' Column A: 1 a warm day tomorrow, 2 go to Paris, 3 finish your homework, 4 don't feel well, 5 earn a lot of money. Column B: a see a doctor, b buy a yacht, c go to the beach, d visit the Eiffel Tower, e watch TV. SA: What will you do if it's a warm day tomorrow? SB: If it's a warm day tomorrow, I'll go to the beach.
9) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or future simple.' SURAT: erkak qayiqni tuzatyapti. 1 If Mark ...... (repair) the boat, we ...... (go) fishing. 2 When you ...... (come) home, I ...... (read) you the letter. 3 When I ...... (grow) up, I ...... (become) an astronaut. 4 If she ...... (call) me, I ...... (tell) her the news. 5 If he ...... (not/cook) dinner, we ...... (order) a pizza. 6 When Barbara ...... (open) the door, we ...... (sing) Happy Birthday.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '27'.

sections.title: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous

exercises.instructionEn: George and Irene have decided to leave the city. Say what they intend to do and what they have arranged to do (continued). • move to the country/March 12 • buy a farm • get a puppy • take their children to their new school/September 7 • have a house-warming party
exercises.instructionUz: Jorj va Ayrin shaharni tark etishga qaror qilishdi. Ular nima qilmoqchi (niyat) va nimani kelishib qo'ygan (aniq reja) ekanini ayting (davomi). • move to the country/March 12 • buy a farm • get a puppy • take their children to their new school/September 7 • have a house-warming party
exercises.explanationUz:
SANA BOR → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
  (kelishuv); SANA YO'Q → GOING TO
  (niyat).

  3 March 12 → They ARE MOVING to
    the country on March 12.
  4 → They ARE GOING TO BUY a
    farm.
  5 → They ARE GOING TO GET a
    puppy.
  6 September 7 → They ARE TAKING
    their children to their new
    school on September 7.
  7 → They ARE GOING TO HAVE a
    house-warming party.


⚠ 'A HOUSE-WARMING PARTY':

  = yangi uy ziyofati (uy to'yi).


⚠ 'A PUPPY':

  = kuchukcha.
exercises.exampleEn: They are hiring movers on March 12. They are going to sell their flat in the city.
exercises.exampleUz: Ular 12-martda yuk tashuvchilarni yollashyapti. Ular kvartirasini sotmoqchi.
modelAnswers: 3 They are moving to the country on March 12.
4 They are going to buy a farm.
5 They are going to get a puppy.
6 They are taking their children to their new school on September 7.
7 They are going to have a house-warming party.
modelAnswersUz: 6 Ular 7-sentabrda bolalarini yangi maktabga olib borishyapti. (sana → kelishuv)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the future simple or the present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni future simple yoki present continuous shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
WILL (qaror, bashorat, iltimos)
  yoki PRESENT CONTINUOUS
  (kelishuv)?

  1 is coming (kelishuv - ertaga)
  2 'll get (shu zahoti qaror)
  3 Are you driving (kelishuv -
    seshanba) / 'Will you drive'
    (iltimos) ham mumkin
  4 is flying (kelishuv)
  5 will be (fakt - yosh)
  6 is having (kelishuv)
  7 Will you do (iltimos)
  8 are celebrating (kelishuv)
  9 are the Greens leaving
    (kelishuv)
  10 will live (bashorat)


⚠ 'A WEDDING ANNIVERSARY':

  = to'y yilligi.


⚠ 'THE BAHAMAS':

  = Bagama orollari.

items.textEn: The repairman ___ (come) to fix the washing machine tomorrow.
A: I'm cold. B: I ___ (get) you an extra blanket.
___ (you/drive) me to the airport on Tuesday?
items.whyUz: ⚠ Seshanba - kelishuv → Continuous ('Will you drive' - iltimos ham mumkin).

items.textEn: Rachel ___ (fly) to the Bahamas next week.
She ___ (have) lunch with Doug this afternoon.
Rob and Molly ___ (celebrate) their wedding anniversary on Sunday.
People ___ (live) in underwater cities in the future.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the prompts in column A to the ones in column B. Then, complete the dialogues below, as in the example. Column A: 1 a warm day tomorrow, 2 go to Paris, 3 finish your homework, 4 don't feel well, 5 earn a lot of money. Column B: a see a doctor, b buy a yacht, c go to the beach, d visit the Eiffel Tower, e watch TV.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustundagi ko'rsatmalarni B ustundagilarga moslang. So'ng namunadagidek dialoglarni to'ldiring. A: 1 ertaga iliq kun, 2 Parijga borish, 3 uy vazifasini tugatish, 4 o'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, 5 ko'p pul topish. B: a shifokorga uchrash, b yaxta sotib olish, c plyajga borish, d Eyfel minorasini ziyorat qilish, e televizor ko'rish.
exercises.explanationUz:
MOSLASh: 1-c, 2-d, 3-e, 4-a, 5-b.

  SAVOL: What will you do if + ega
    + PRESENT SIMPLE?
  JAVOB: If + ..., I'LL + fe'l.

  ⚠ 'if' qismida present simple
  (will emas!).


⚠ 'TO EARN MONEY':

  = pul topmoq (ishlab).
exercises.exampleEn: 1 SA: What will you do if it's a warm day tomorrow? SB: If it's a warm day tomorrow, I'll go to the beach.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Ertaga iliq kun bo'lsa nima qilasan? B: Ertaga iliq kun bo'lsa, plyajga boraman.
modelAnswers: 1 (c) A: What will you do if it's a warm day tomorrow? B: If it's a warm day tomorrow, I'll go to the beach.
2 (d) A: What will you do if you go to Paris? B: If I go to Paris, I'll visit the Eiffel Tower.
3 (e) A: What will you do if you finish your homework? B: If I finish my homework, I'll watch TV.
4 (a) A: What will you do if you don't feel well? B: If I don't feel well, I'll see a doctor.
5 (b) A: What will you do if you earn a lot of money? B: If I earn a lot of money, I'll buy a yacht.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Ertaga iliq kun bo'lsa nima qilasan? - Plyajga boraman. (NAMUNA)
2 Parijga borsang nima qilasan? - Parijga borsam, Eyfel minorasini ziyorat qilaman.
3 Uy vazifangni tugatsang nima qilasan? - Tugatsam, televizor ko'raman.
4 O'zingni yaxshi his qilmasang nima qilasan? - Yaxshi his qilmasam, shifokorga boraman.
5 Ko'p pul topsang nima qilasan? - Ko'p pul topsam, yaxta sotib olaman.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or future simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki future simple shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR ShART GAP: if/when + PRESENT
  SIMPLE, + WILL.

  1 If Mark REPAIRS, we WILL GO
  2 When you COME, I WILL READ
  3 When I GROW up, I WILL BECOME
  4 If she CALLS, I WILL TELL
  5 If he DOESN'T COOK, we WILL
    ORDER
  6 When Barbara OPENS, we WILL
    SING

  ⚠ if/when qismida 3-shaxs → -s
  (repairs, calls, opens).


⚠ 'TO GROW UP':

  = katta bo'lmoq, ulg'aymoq.


⚠ 'AN ASTRONAUT':

  = astronavt.

items.textEn: If Mark ___ (repair) the boat, we ___ (go) fishing.
items.whyUz: ⚠ If Mark repairs (3-shaxs -s), we will go.

items.textEn: When you ___ (come) home, I ___ (read) you the letter.
items.whyUz: ⚠ When you come, I will read.

items.textEn: When I ___ (grow) up, I ___ (become) an astronaut.
items.whyUz: ⚠ When I grow up, I will become.

items.textEn: If she ___ (call) me, I ___ (tell) her the news.
items.whyUz: ⚠ If she calls (-s), I will tell.

items.textEn: If he ___ (not/cook) dinner, we ___ (order) a pizza.
items.whyUz: ⚠ If he doesn't cook, we will order.

items.textEn: When Barbara ___ (open) the door, we ___ (sing) Happy Birthday.
items.whyUz: ⚠ When Barbara opens (-s), we will sing.

patterns.formula: What will you do if + KIM + FE'L(s)? — If ..., I'll + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: What will you do if it's a warm day tomorrow? — If it's a warm day tomorrow, I'll go to the beach.
patterns.exampleUz: Ertaga iliq kun bo'lsa nima qilasan? — Iliq bo'lsa, plyajga boraman.

patterns.formula: When + KIM + FE'L(s), KIM + will + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: When I grow up, I will become an astronaut.

patterns.formula: KIM + is + V-ing + VAQT (kelishuv) / KIM + will + FE'L (bashorat)
patterns.exampleEn: Rachel is flying to the Bahamas next week. People will live in underwater cities in the future.
patterns.exampleUz: Reychel keyingi hafta Bagamaga uchadi. Kelajakda odamlar suv osti shaharlarida yashaydi.
